content: The Twins are ready to enter the Genesis Horn. The spatial turbulence will be more intense there. We'll need to use strings to hold the Horn, but who knows how long we can drag it...

raw: [name="Lessing"]Go. This is something only a Lich can do.
speaker: Lessing
content: Go. This is something only a Lich can do.

raw: [name="Lessing"]As for me, I must cover the old man and Ebenholz's retreat.
speaker: Lessing
content: As for me, I must cover the old man and Ebenholz's retreat.

raw: [name="Lessing"]Only by blocking these dark... things can the people be safe. That's the only way those who've entered the Genesis Horn can return safely.
speaker: Lessing
content: Only by blocking these dark... things can the people be safe. That's the only way those who've entered the Genesis Horn can return safely.

raw: [name="Ermengarde"]Do you need me to stitch up your wounds for you?
speaker: Ermengarde
content: Do you need me to stitch up your wounds for you?

speaker: Lessing
content: Nein. The pain... keeps me awake.

raw: [name="Ermengarde"]I nearly forgot. Right, that's what allows you to move undisturbed by the notes.
speaker: Ermengarde
content: I nearly forgot. Right, that's what allows you to move undisturbed by the notes.

raw: [name="Ermengarde"]Unlike the other Leithanians in the amphitheater, who've mostly succumbed to the altered tune of the Güldenesgesatz.
speaker: Ermengarde
content: Unlike the other Leithanians in the amphitheater, who've mostly succumbed to the altered tune of the Güldenesgesatz.

raw: [name="Ermengarde"]That's a good thing too. If they heard the sounds of the remnants emanating from the land of the dead, they'd lose their minds.
speaker: Ermengarde
content: That's a good thing too. If they heard the sounds of the remnants emanating from the land of the dead, they'd lose their minds.

raw: [name="Lessing"]The Gesatzswächter and the Twin Empresses are doing what they can to weave melodies and defend the people's sanity.
speaker: Lessing
content: The Gesatzswächter and the Twin Empresses are doing what they can to weave melodies and defend the people's sanity.

raw: [name="Lessing"]Once the Kaiserinnen stop playing and enter the Genesis Horn, only the Gesatzswächter will be left.
speaker: Lessing
content: Once the Kaiserinnen stop playing and enter the Genesis Horn, only the Gesatzswächter will be left.

raw: [name="Ermengarde"]Their Arts are very strong, but Arts are Arts. How can they resist the chaos of the void?
speaker: Ermengarde
content: Their Arts are very strong, but Arts are Arts. How can they resist the chaos of the void?

speaker: Ermengarde
content: The same goes for you, Lessing.

raw: [name="Ermengarde"]Both your body and your will are being consumed. Your blood will run dry.
speaker: Ermengarde
content: Both your body and your will are being consumed. Your blood will run dry.

raw: [name="Lessing"]Are you saying... that I'm not an immortal Lich?
speaker: Lessing
content: Are you saying... that I'm not an immortal Lich?

speaker: Ermengarde
content: So what if you were?

raw: [name="Ermengarde"]It is precisely because we're Liches that we understand the absolute nature of chaos. It's like unto boundless knowledge.
speaker: Ermengarde
content: It is precisely because we're Liches that we understand the absolute nature of chaos. It's like unto boundless knowledge.

speaker: Lessing
content: Then... what should we do?

raw: [name="Lessing"]Admit our insignificance and helplessness, do nothing, and wait for a greater power to crush us? Wait for your chaos to devour us?
speaker: Lessing
content: Admit our insignificance and helplessness, do nothing, and wait for a greater power to crush us? Wait for your chaos to devour us?

speaker: Lessing
content: I won't.

raw: [name="Lessing"]I'd rather take my life into my own hands, and listen to the sound of the last drop of blood falling from my wounds as I collapse.
speaker: Lessing
content: I'd rather take my life into my own hands, and listen to the sound of the last drop of blood falling from my wounds as I collapse.

speaker: Ermengarde
content: Hmph... stubborn.

raw: [name="Ermengarde"]I still remember all those years ago, when the master rescued you from the Gendarmerie. We all thought you were minutes from death.
speaker: Ermengarde
content: I still remember all those years ago, when the master rescued you from the Gendarmerie. We all thought you were minutes from death.

raw: [name="Ermengarde"]You were so small, so thin, so... fragile. Like you would shatter if touched by a strand of thread.
speaker: Ermengarde
content: You were so small, so thin, so... fragile. Like you would shatter if touched by a strand of thread.

raw: [name="Ermengarde"]But you survived, covered in scars, with a temperament more and more like the master.
speaker: Ermengarde
content: But you survived, covered in scars, with a temperament more and more like the master.

speaker: Lessing
content: ...Danke.

raw: [name="Lessing"]It was you who helped me survive. Just like... the Liches have helped Leithanien for so many years.
speaker: Lessing
content: It was you who helped me survive. Just like... the Liches have helped Leithanien for so many years.

content: Lessing, my unorthodox little brother... I'll listen for your voice on the wind.

content: And before that... is just a battle.
